tasks.label: 🧹 GIT Prune Local Branches
tasks.command: git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short) %(upstream:track)' refs/heads | awk '$2 == "[gone]" {print $1}' | xargs -r git branch -d

tasks.command_that_SILENTLY_REVERT: git add TODO.md && git commit -m 'todo: add task' && git push --force

command_that_SILENTLY_REVERT.label: ☑️ GIT add TODO task
command_that_SILENTLY_REVERT.command: git add TODO.md && git commit -m 'todo: add task' && git pull --rebase --autostash origin main && git push --force

command_that_SILENTLY_REVERT.label: 🏗️ Setup Project
command_that_SILENTLY_REVERT.command: uv venv --clear .venv --python 3.14 && uv pip install -r requirements.txt

command_that_SILENTLY_REVERT.label: 🚀 Run Music-Splitter
command_that_SILENTLY_REVERT.command: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; elif [ -x .venv/Scripts/python.exe ]; then PY=.venv/Scripts/python.exe; else echo 'ERROR: virtualenv not found. Run the "Setup Project" task first.'; exit 1; fi; exec "$PY" main.py

command_that_SILENTLY_REVERT.label: 🧪 Run Tests
command_that_SILENTLY_REVERT.command: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; elif [ -x .venv/Scripts/python.exe ]; then PY=.venv/Scripts/python.exe; else echo 'ERROR: virtualenv not found. Run the "Setup Project" task first.'; exit 1; fi; exec "$PY" -m unittest discover tests
